purpose: Shared current MaterialState binding for scoped owners, bounded to Schedule, Actual and Temporal Constraint material facets.

columns.name: scoped_owner_ref
columns.meaning: Scoped owner address whose current facet is bound.

primary_key.name: pk_scoped_current_material_state
primary_key.reason: At most one current binding per scoped owner and facet.

foreign_keys.name: fk_scoped_current_material_state_owner_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind current control to an existing scoped owner address.

foreign_keys.name: fk_scoped_current_material_state_state_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind current control to one exact material-state address.

unique_constraints.name: uq_scoped_current_material_state_material_state_ref
unique_constraints.reason: One MaterialStateRef cannot be current through two scoped current bindings.

check_constraints.name: ck_scoped_current_material_state_facet_code
check_constraints.reason: Keep scoped current bindings bounded to Schedule, Actual and Temporal Constraint material facets.

indexes.name: uq_scoped_current_material_state_material_state_ref
indexes.reason: Unique reverse current binding by MaterialStateRef.

triggers.name: trg_scoped_current_material_state_current_binding
triggers.reason: Database-local enforcement for current MaterialState owner/facet binding.

triggers.name: ctrg_scoped_current_material_state_current_history
triggers.reason: Database-local enforcement for current/history equivalence across Schedule, Actual and Temporal Constraint scoped facets.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Points to the accepted current MaterialStateRef; it does not own protected payload. B04-A uses it as the current selector for temporal_constraint.rule.
state_history.current_binding: A scoped owner has at most one current MaterialState per bounded facet; for Temporal Constraint retirement removes the rule binding while retained history survives.
state_history.chronology: Facet-specific history preserves currentness chronology independently from payload retention or row insertion order.
state_history.immutability_policy: Direct runtime DML remains denied for B04-A Temporal Constraint mutation; accepted currentness moves only through governed capabilities.

lifecycle.retention: Retain while the current binding is truthful, including when it points to an explicitly retired state for pre-existing facets; Temporal Constraint retire instead removes its current binding.
lifecycle.redaction: Redaction removes protected payload, not the current-reference fact itself where that remains the accepted facet contract.
lifecycle.retirement_tombstone: Resolve applicable MaterialStateRef retirement semantics per facet; B04-A constraint retirement is represented by closed current history plus absence of temporal_constraint.rule current binding.
